settings.hero_body: You can appreciate a great gift idea and still want it for yourself. Eight colorful companions, one complete set, and no special occasion required.
settings.detail_title: Eight designs, down to the details.
settings.detail_body: Look closely at the embroidered faces, colorful hoods and little brown paws. Every companion brings its own silhouette to the collection you have been picturing.
settings.final_title: Go ahead. Put your name on it.
settings.final_body: The complete eight-plush set can be your own next little joy.
settings.moods_title: You do not have to pick a favorite.
settings.moods_body: All eight are included, even if one is already destined for your bedside.
settings.personality_body: Maybe you have had a shelf in mind for a while. Maybe you simply like the crew. Make the collection part of a corner you enjoy spending time in.
settings.hand_note: Eight companions. Every pictured design included.
